Class GrokSettingsDocument.Entry

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.GrokSettingsDocument.Entry
Enclosing class:
GrokSettingsDocument
static final class GrokSettingsDocument.Entry extends Object
The Entry class is one settings object. The API starts as chat. The model starts as grok-4.3. The reasoning effort starts as high. Stream starts off. The burner-cloud flag starts off. The temperature starts at 1.0. The completion cap starts at 128000.

  • Method Details

    • copy

      GrokSettingsDocument.Entry copy()
      The method returns a separate entry with the same values. A null or empty API becomes chat. A null model becomes empty. The effort is passed through GrokSettingsDocument.normalizeEffort(String, String).
      Returns:
      The return value is the copied entry.
